deployed.note: Previous live sha was 794ee295 — Phases 1, 4, 6 and 2 were also undeployed until this push.

premise_correction.audit_claimed: 78 of 360 mutating actions had vendor read-back (~22%); 282 rested on accepted_async.
premise_correction.actually_found: The 78 were catalog DECLARATIONS. Only 3 executed at runtime — schedule_write_success_verification returned early for every non-membership action, so the 75 follow_up_entity_get declarations were inert.

delivered.alias_bug_found_and_fixed: The executability gate checked raw registry membership while invoke_tool resolves aliases first, so 5 Google reads (google_drive.files.get -> drive.files.get) were being rejected as read_action_not_registered despite executing fine.
delivered.honesty_fix: accepted_async set verified=True, so an unproven write rendered the green 'Verified' pill and reached the 'verified' lifecycle state, with 'completion is not yet proven' demoted to a collapsed detail line. Split into three states; a vendor acknowledgement now reads 'Accepted — not yet confirmed'.
